name: Bybit BTC/USDT microprice
description: For each fresh reconstructed Bybit level-two book, microprice is (ask times bid size plus bid times ask size) divided by total touch size. microprice_deviation_bps is (microprice minus the book midpoint) divided by that midpoint times 10000, so a positive value indicates touch-size pressure toward the ask. Ready output requires a complete positive uncrossed Bybit book no more than 10 seconds old. This identity is single-venue: it reads only Bybit inputs and is ready whenever the Bybit book is complete, uncrossed, and inside the staleness bound, independently of the other adopted spot venue. The blended `btc.external.*` reading of the same measurement stays the reference layer and continues to require every adopted venue (ADR 0024). Decimal outputs are rounded to eight places using round-half-to-even. Venue port (B1): this identity is the Bybit sibling of `btc.coinbase.spot_microprice@1.0.0` and reuses that definition's formulas, windows, thresholds, warm-up, staleness bound, field set, field types and eight-place round-half-to-even rounding verbatim; only the source ids differ (`crates/btc-signals/src/spot_signals.rs`, `crates/btc-signals/src/candidate_spot_signals.rs`). The instrument is Bybit spot BTCUSDT; at decision time every price-level field is converted from the venue's USDT quote to USD via the Kraken USDT/USD mid, while ratio fields (basis points, imbalances, ratios, counts) are quote-currency neutral. Bybit inputs are rights-gated (`signals/knowledge/RIGHTS-LEDGER.md`): the lane is built and tested to the adopted standard, and its runtime refuses to start unless the environment allow-list `SIGNALS_ENABLED_VENUES` names `bybit`, which the deployment sets only after that row clears. The Bybit book input is the `orderbook.200.BTCUSDT` stream (100 ms, snapshot plus delta, 200 levels per side). `update_kind` carries the venue's own snapshot/delta semantics, so the Coinbase snapshot and delta rules port unchanged. Event time is the venue `cts` when present (`event_time_basis` = `source`) and the local receipt time otherwise (`receipt`). Ordering is the per-topic `update_id`; a repeated or lower id is dropped, and a delta before a seeding snapshot awaits a fresh snapshot. quote_currency is emitted on every decision and is the constant "usd" for this venue: every price-denominated field is converted from the venue's USDT quote to USD via the Kraken USDT/USD mid, while ratio, basis-point, base-size and count fields are quote-currency neutral. E47 (USD quoting): this identity quotes in USD. The venue trades BTC against USDT, so at decision time every price, notional and quote-denominated cost field (microprice, book_midpoint) is converted USDT to USD with the latest USDT/USD reference rate; base-denominated fields (base sizes, counts, basis-point ratios, durations) are unchanged. The reference is kraken.spot.usdt-usd.ticker, delivered on the dedicated Kraken reference socket (a second reference, coinbase.exchange.usdt-usd.ticker, joins when it lands). quote_currency is the constant "usd". usdt_usd_rate (decimal, eight places, round-half-to-even) and usdt_usd_rate_age_ms are published on every ready decision, and the identity is non-ready with reason usdt_reference_stale when the rate is absent or older than 60000 milliseconds.
